title: NOW! Programs® - Videos
description:
Welcome to Neuro-development of Words - NOW!® / NOW! Programs® company's YouTube channel.
NOW! Programs® evidence-based programs can prevent or empower learning difficulties. With global services online for children, teenagers, college students and adults, anyone  experiencing difficulty with reading/spelling, memory/comprehension, writing, mathematics and academic struggles can access empowering help. 
Click videos below to see students reading before and after their empowerment
See parents, teachers, & students' real success. 
Learn from Dr. Tim Conway's (neuropsychologist and CEO of the NOW! Programs®) info videos.  

What is Dr Conway’s neuropsych research & expertise?  See https://www.Linkedin.com/in/TimConwayPhDTheMorrisCenter
OR http://TimConway.Academia.edu

NOW! Programs "close the gaps" (puts students' skills on/above grade level) & ends tutoring.
See www.NOWprograms.com more info.

Ready for your student to "close the gaps"? 
Book a FREE consult https://www.NOWprograms.com
